tool.name: Gemini Spark
tool.description: Consumer 24/7 personal agent in the Gemini app that runs in Google's cloud and acts across Gmail, Docs, Slides and connected apps.
strengths: Runs on Gemini 3.5 with Antigravity harness
Native Gmail, Docs and Slides integration
Asks before spending money or sending email
tool.pricing: Beta planned for US Google AI Ultra subscribers at launch.
tool.statusNote: Announced at Google I/O in May 2026: trusted-tester rollout, then a beta for US Google AI Ultra subscribers.
tool.practitionerNote: Launched on consumer Google AI subscriptions, not as a managed Workspace admin feature, so check the account type before connecting work mail. The launch post names no business or enterprise availability.

dataResidency.detail: No data-residency controls stated for Spark.

deployment.detail: Google-hosted cloud agent that keeps running when the user's devices are off.

auditLogging.detail: No audit logging described in the launch post.
